title: Support saltedlolly
name: Olly Stedall
bio: Hi, I'm Olly, also known as saltedlolly. I build free, open source software that makes it easier to run your own server at home, including DigiNode Tools and the saltedlolly App Store for Umbrel.
It's all built in my spare time. If this app has saved you time or effort, a donation of any size is hugely appreciated and helps keep these projects going.

methods.label: Donate with Ko-fi
methods.note: One-off donation by card or PayPal. No account needed.

methods.label: Sponsor on GitHub
methods.note: One-off or monthly. Needs a GitHub account.
